in_marathi.name: Ilakkiya
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Illusion
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ilakkiya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ilakkiya is the name of the goddess of illusion, known as Maya in Hindu mythology. She is the creator of the universe through her power of illusion. This name is believed to bestow the ability to see beyond the physical world and understand the deeper truths of existence.
